title: Upma
description: Dry-roasted semolina cooked with tempered mustard seeds, curry leaves and vegetables — a quick, savoury breakfast staple across South India.
steps: Dry roast the sooji in a pan over medium heat, stirring continuously, for 4-5 minutes until lightly golden and fragrant. Set aside.
In the same pan, heat oil. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter, then add the urad dal, chana dal and dried red chilli, frying until the dals turn golden.
Add the curry leaves, onion, green chillies and ginger, and sauté until the onion is translucent.
Add the green peas if using and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the water and salt, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and slowly pour in the roasted sooji, stirring continuously to prevent lumps.
Cover and cook on low heat for 3-4 minutes, stirring once, until the water is fully absorbed and the upma is soft and fluffy. Garnish with coriander leaves before serving.
